quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Anika said to her manager, "I sent you my report yesterday."

quests.nativeTip: This sentence combines four changes: the verb tense, the pronoun, the possessive, and the time word.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Anika said to her manager, "I sent you my report yesterday."" ➔ "Anika told her manager that she had sent him her report the day before."
